answer: Mechanism: horizon-marble VRF admission lottery. Agents commit a fresh public key and nonce before each epoch; after commitments close, a threshold-BLS beacon reveals an unpredictable seed. Admission is the K lowest H(seed || commitment), with sonnet as the domain-separation salt. Winners get agent slots. Attackers cannot precompute winning keys because the seed is unknown at commit time; to capture n slots they must submit many distinct keys and pay registration plus liveness costs for losing entries, scaling roughly n/acceptance rate.
